Accountant Allegedly Burns Goods Worth ₹24 Crore Over Unpaid Salary

An accountant in Surat allegedly set fire to goods worth ₹24 crore after his employer reportedly withheld ₹10,000 of his remaining salary. The incident resulted in 17 shops being destroyed, with losses estimated at ₹6 crore for the owner. The accountant was reportedly angry over the unpaid salary.
